svg.title: Hermes AI — Detailed system architecture v3
svg.desc: Detailed architecture map of Hermes AI showing the human and untrusted input layer, browser PWA, mandatory deterministic preflight, Dynamic Trust Engine, optional real Strands Agent providers, guarded tools, family authorization, persistence, pre-launch simulation and the blocked external side-effect boundary.
svg.text: Trust-first orchestration · deterministic authorization boundary · local-by-default prototype · no external side effects
The user decides; external content is evidence only and never grants consent or permissions.
Family roles: owner · partner · teen · trusted person
Untrusted inputs: email · documents · calendar · alerts
Commands: task · approve · reject · explain · undo
Human approval is independent from model confidence and Dynamic Trust
Browser PWA · works without the optional backend
localStorage state-v2 · preferences · tasks · UI state
Offline UI is not offline execution: no connector is available.
create · approve · reject · defer · explain · recovery
Strands trace card: preflight · provider status · tool lifecycle
No browser button bypasses the policy gate.
The deterministic Hermes preflight is authoritative; Strands is a guarded reasoning/orchestration layer.
Every provider and every model starts here
REAL STRANDS PATH / ONLY WHEN READY
provider-aware · optional dependency · no external tools
read-only or local draft; never a connector
prepared locally · digest · confirmation required · blocked
trace: tool names + lifecycle labels only; no prompt, arguments, documents or model text retained
Trust influences convenience; safety, consent and role authorization remain independent.
These rules can force confirmation or block.
EXTERNAL SIDE-EFFECT GATE / BLOCKED IN SUBMISSION
Receives a local request record only · no bank, vendor, email, calendar, health, booking or smart-home credentials.
Sensitive or irreversible work remains human-controlled even when trust is high.
Retention, export, deletion and offboarding are explicit product controls; production encryption/managed audit still require implementation.
lifecycle_simulation.py · synthetic data · seeded 180–730 days · design evidence, not a safety certification
daily log · notification volume · trust trajectories · avoided interruptions
contradictions found · rule corrections · attack outcomes · reproducible seed
Feeds design review only; it does not prove production reliability or legal compliance.
SIMULATION INPUTS ARE ISOLATED FROM REAL USERS, PROVIDERS, CREDENTIALS AND THIRD-PARTY SYSTEMS
Separate deployment paths make the prototype honest about what is live, local, optional or future-only.
Node server · static PWA + landing site
no private model, AWS key or live connector
secrets stay outside GitHub and browser state
OAuth · Open Banking · email · calendar · health · pharmacy · booking · vendors · smart home
Required before production: least privilege · idempotency · confirmation binding · monitoring · kill switch · incident response
Any future connector must remain behind the same policy, consent, role and execution gateway.
BOUNDARY GUARANTEE IN THIS SUBMISSION: NO PAYMENT · NO EMAIL · NO BOOKING · NO HEALTH UPDATE · NO DELETION
